test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Vigorously.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vigorously: ** in a way that is very forceful or energetic.

 
 
• Environmentalists and local government officials have **vigorously** opposed the project.&
